title: Customer Success Operations Manager
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Reporting into the Customer Success Operations - Senior Manager based out of the USA, the Customer Success Operations Manager (CSOM) will work as part of the EMEA Regional Sales team, supporting both the Sales and CSM teams. The role will be engaged around activities related to the customer experience, including providing support for initial customer onboarding, driving overall customer satisfaction, and helping to grow and retain revenue on existing accounts.
This role will be responsible for facilitating internal activities related to the customer, including coordinating activity between teams within Megaport. Passionate about the customer experience, you will be tasked with supporting and delivering on Megaport’s value to continually strive to increase customer satisfaction.
The position will sit within the broader Commercial Team, working closely alongside our Customer Success Managers, as well as Solutions Architects. The CSOM will play an integral role within the team and, ultimately, be responsible for providing support for ongoing commercial interactions with the global customer base, aiming to expand, retain and develop, and drive increased value from customers.
Tasked with supporting and delivering on Megaport’s value proposition, you will continually strive to increase customer dependency from the numerous and ever-growing range of Megaport benefits.

Centre de ressources de la Médiation numérique en Provence Alpes Côte d'Azur. L'association ARSENIC PACA reprend le dispositif HUB du SUD (Hub pour un numérique inclusif de l'ANCT) en 2022 avec pour vocation l'accompagnement des politiques publiques dans la mise en oeuvre de projet d'inclusion numérique et de médiation numérique sur les territoires.
Réseau régional des acteurs des médiations et de l’inclusion numériques depuis 2009, Arsenic relance son activité après une période réduite de deux ans.
Qu’il s’agisse du Plan France Relance, des dynamiques enclenchées par les Hubs pour un numérique inclusif ainsi que des dispositifs comme cele des Conseillers Numériques France Services ou d’Aidant Connect, l’accompagnement des populations sur leurs usages numériques est une partie intégrante des politiques publiques nationales et locales auxquelles Arsenic est appelé à prendre part.

La mission sera réalisée en lien étroit avec les membres du Bureau de l’association, à la fois lors de réunions (présentielles et distancielles) et par l’intermédiaire de plateformes collaboratives en ligne.
Cette mission nécessite une autonomie importante de fonctionnement.

About Orange Sky Aotearoa / Mō Orange Sky Aotearoa
Orange Sky is the world’s first free mobile laundry and shower service, providing support to people experiencing homelessness and hardship. Launched in Aotearoa in 2018, after beginning in Australia, our kaupapa is to connect communities through working alongside service partners and community groups to uphold the dignity and mana of friends and whānau experiencing homelessness and hardship.
In Aotearoa, we are privileged to walk alongside whānau and communities in need, fostering genuine connections through clean clothes, warm showers, and meaningful kōrero. With 41,600 Kiwis (1 in 120) experiencing homelessness, our kaupapa is to break down barriers and bring people together through acts of connection and kindness. We’re driven, dedicated, insanely ambitious and a little unconventional. We take our work seriously but have plenty of fun along the way. We work hard and ‘get it done’ but always make time to celebrate each other’s success.
The Role / Te Tūranga
The role of an Orange Sky Director is to provide strategic leadership and direction, to monitor financial performance and oversee the Chief Executive Officer (who sits across both Australia and Aotearoa). Directors must fulfil their corporate governance and fiduciary obligations and responsibilities with care and due diligence to the best of their abilities to ensure the long-term sustainability of Orange Sky. Directors act in a volunteer capacity.

• 1 meeting/hui every 2 months + ad hoc meetings and events in NZ

• 1-2 hours of prep per meeting

• 45 minute monthly call with the CEO and joining the Orange Sky Australia Board meeting once per year

• Attend an Orange Sky shift each quarter (location dependent)

• 3 year term with potential to extend

About You / Mōu
Orange Sky is seeking a Chair who is passionate about partnering with the CEO and Board to advance our strategic vision and create meaningful impact across Aotearoa. This role requires a collaborative leader who can foster strong governance, support organisational growth and demonstrate a genuine commitment to working alongside Tangata Whenua in a way that honours Te Tiriti o Waitangi and its principles.
We would particularly love to hear from candidates who can bring:

• Board Chair Experience - Proven experience leading a Board of Directors, including facilitating effective meetings, fostering constructive and inclusive discussion, supporting strong Board performance and building a productive partnership with the CEO.

• Governance, Finance and Risk Expertise - Strong knowledge of corporate governance, financial oversight and risk management, with the ability to interpret financial reports, support sound decision-making and ensure compliance with relevant legal and regulatory obligations.

Licensed Clinical Social Worker (Full-time / Remote)

About Survivor Healthcare

Survivor Healthcare is a telehealth clinic dedicated to improving the quality of life for people with cancer. We bridge the gap between primary care and oncology, delivering virtual, evidence-based supportive care throughout treatment and survivorship.

Work alongside a multidisciplinary team-oncology, occupational therapy, mental health, nutrition, and translational research-while practicing at the top of your license in a fully remote setting.

The Role

We’re seeking a full-time LCSW who is passionate about helping cancer survivors manage symptoms, navigate treatment, and achieve their personal health goals. You’ll thrive here if you’re patient-centered, adaptable, and energized by collaborative, integrated care.

What You’ll Do

• Complete biopsychosocial evaluations for new patients; identify needs, strengths, and goals

• Deliver individualized therapy using evidence-based modalities

• Build rapport with patients and families; provide psychoeducation and resource navigation

• Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team to create integrated, patient-centered care plans

title: Support Systems Engineer
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote across North America and London - we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

We're building a tool that makes content creation easy and accessible for all types of creatives. Our users love it. Runway has an actively engaged and growing community of passionate artists and creators worldwide. And we're scaling the systems behind our support team so we can keep delivering delightful experiences as that community grows.

We're looking for a Support Systems Engineer who ships production code, not tickets and specs: someone who takes a fix from proposal to merged PR themselves. This role reports directly to the Head of Customer Experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the AI support agent, our ticketing system and other Support tools end to end: authentication (JWT), response logic, routing, escalation paths and tone, tested in staging before it sees live traffic

- Ship daily product changes that remove ticket volume. Recent example: extending automatic refund eligibility to one-click credit purchases, accidental upgrades and month-based proration on annual terms

- Build and maintain internal CX tooling as real software, not one-offs: scripts, jobs, dashboards, admin surfaces

- Run QA and evals with real test suites and pass/fail rubrics, plus monitoring and alerts for outages, bugs and volume spikes

- Own releases: staged rollouts, a regression suite before every ship, clear rollback criteria, a writeup when something reaches production

- Build the CX reporting the org runs on: volume, deflection, CSAT, reply and resolution time, escalation accuracy, agent spend. You own the correctness and availability of the queries.

- Build and stage the guardrails on refunds, account changes and anything touching money or PII, including the audit trail

- Keep the knowledge base accurate and structured for the agent to parse, and manage the handoff into the ticketing system

- Keep the CX roadmap and the coverage model current, sequenced against priorities set by the Head of CX, so gaps show up before they bite

- Run the day-to-day with our AI platform vendor: weekly working session, joint roadmap, issues filed with reproductions

- Carry signal across teams: Product and Engineering on bugs and rollouts, Customer Education on self-serve, community on Discord and the forums, GTM and Analytics on routing and reporting

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Engineering or Support Operations, with real time spent writing code

- You ship production code in codebases you didn't write: read TypeScript, trace logic through someone else's service, put up a PR that survives review. Our stack is TypeScript and Node.js on AWS

- Hands-on experience building and tuning AI or LLM-powered support workflows: prompt and context engineering, routing, escalation design, evals

- SQL experience. You own the reporting, so you shouldn't be waiting on Analytics for it

- Code-level experience with a billing or payments A

The Martin Center’s goal is to renew and fulfill the promise of higher education in North Carolina and across the country by educating citizens and policymakers and advocating policies grounded in classical liberal principles. title: Research Engineer
description:
About Us
Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.
Higharc is hiring a Research Engineer to join our Special Projects team. In this role, you'll conduct foundational research in spatial AI for residential construction - developing novel approaches at the intersection of reinforcement learning, computer vision, LLMs, and 3D geometry to solve problems that have no off-the-shelf solutions.
What You'll Do
You'll produce the research capabilities that power Higharc 's AI platform, working on problems that don't exist anywhere else. Expect to:

• Design and conduct original research in spatial reasoning for residential construction, developing models that understand architectural structure, spatial relationships between building components, and the geometric constraints that govern how homes can be built.

• Design end-to-end LLM training and fine-tuning pipelines tailored to construction domains, developing domain-specific pre-training and SFT datasets from architectural drawings, building codes, product specifications, and construction documentation.

• Apply computer vision techniques to extract semantic structure from architectural inputs and develop multimodal training pipelines that link visual and textual representations of building data, enabling models that reason across drawings, specifications, and code requirements simultaneously.

• Develop RL-based approaches for generative architectural design and architect RAG systems that ground LLM outputs in authoritative construction knowledge bases, reducing hallucination for high-stakes building decisions.

• Define construction-domain benchmarks, build ground-truth datasets, and establish eval pipelines that measure model performance against real homebuilding tasks rather than generic benchmarks. Research emerging foundation models and parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches (LoRA, QLoRA, adapter layers) to inform Higharc 's model strategy.

• Deliver research outputs ready for integration, including documented model artifacts, serving-ready pipelines, and clear API contracts, and partner with the Prototyping Engineer to deploy fine-tuned models and RAG systems into the Higharc platform.

About You
You do your best work when you can go deep. You treat residential construction as a worthy and complex problem space, not a stepping stone to a more prestigious domain, and you bring the same intellectual honesty to negative results as to positive ones. You understand that research that never ships is indistinguishable from research that never happened.
You have:

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly on LLM development, fine-tuning, or applied ML systems in production

• Hands-on experience with model training frameworks (HuggingFace Transformers, PyTorch) and fine-tuning workflows on domain-specific corpora

• Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), and embedding model selection

• Experience with 3D modeling, computational geometry, or computer graphics in a research or production context

• Strong proficiency in Python across the ML ecosystem; React/TypeScript proficiency for integration work

• A Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a closely related field

A major plus if you also bring:

• A Ph.D., particularly for candidates focused on model research and pre-training

• Open-source contributions or published research

• Familiarity with BIM tools (Revit, AutoCAD) or BIM data formats (IFC, gbXML)

• Experience with Three.js or equivalent 3D frameworks

title: Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) — AI & Zero Trust Security
description:
Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) - AI & Zero Trust Security
Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity
The short version: NetFoundry , the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry 's outbound engine. This is a hunter role selling Zero Trust connectivity into cybersecurity, cloud, and AI infrastructure teams. If you want to build the playbook instead of inheriting one and have ambition to become an AE, keep reading.
Why this matters now:
AI broke the network security model.
Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.
NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.
Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.
We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.
The role:
We have one SDR today. We're hiring two more, and we're building the enterprise go-to-market motion around you.
That means the target account strategy, the sequences, the call openers, the objection handling, the way we mine our open source community for enterprise signal - isn't fully developed yet. You'll contribute to it working directly with our AEs, our marketing team, and GTM leadership that has built and exited multiple startups.
This is the right role if you want to be early. It's the wrong role if you want a machine that already runs.
A note on leads: This is an outbound focused role. Marketing supports you with content, campaigns, and intent data. Pieline starts with you, on the phone.
What you'll do:

• Own outbound pipeline generation into a defined set of enterprise accounts - you build the list, you work the list

• Cold call. Daily. This is the core of the job, not a footnote

• Run multi-channel outbound across phone, email, and LinkedIn, with real personalization rather than merge fields

• Run discovery that surfaces real pain: firewall and VPN sprawl, exposed APIs, OT segmentation projects, AI agents that need access to sensitive systems

• Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and hit monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

• Build account plans with AEs and multi-thread into security, networking, cloud, and platform teams

• Act as our fastest feedback loop since you'll hear what the market says before anyone else. Leadership will change the messaging based on what you report.

What we're looking for:

• Ambition to become an AE

• 1-3 years in outbound SDR/BDR or inside sales, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology

• A track record you can put numbers to - activity, meetings booked, pipeline sourced, quota attainment

• Genuine willingness to cold call, and the resilience to do it on the days it isn't working

• Strong written communication; you can write an email a CISO would actually reply to

• Comfort with technical buyers, and curiosity to learn what a firewall rule, a service mesh, and an AI agent actually are

• Experience with CRM and sales engagement platforms (we run HubSpot)

• Organized, coachable, and hard to discourage

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Are you a hands-on sales professional who can both win deals and build the infrastructure that makes a sales team more effective? Do you have the commercial instincts to prospect, qualify, and close with senior buyers, while simultaneously building the assets and tracking systems the team needs to scale? If so, this might just be the role for you.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Sales Manager who can drive revenue growth by building, managing, and closing a strong pipeline of B2B deals for ALX Enterprise, our corporate training business, and closing other revenue-generating partnerships that support the long-term sustainability of ALX’s mission.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills, training, and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

• Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.

• Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.

• Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey. 

Our impact thus far:

• 347k+ graduates since 2020

• 257k youth in work

• 31k youth starting own ventures

• 60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs

 Visit our website www.alxafrica.com to learn more about our digital revolution.

About ALX Enterprise

ALX Enterprise is our corporate training business. We help ambitious organisations build the leaders and workforce they need through executive education, leadership development, and digital and AI skills programmes. Our clients include pan-African banks, telcos, FMCG and energy companies across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Rwanda, Morocco and Côte d'Ivoire. Revenue from ALX Enterprise directly helps sustain ALX's mission.

Visit our website enterprise.alxafrica.com to learn more about how we transform corporate team performance with measurable results.

Role Summary

As an Enterprise Sales Manager, your mandate is to close deals and generate revenue to contribute to our organisation's financial sustainability. In this role, you will be responsible for hands-on sales activity, building and converting a strong sales pipeline, and establishing revenue-generating partnerships. You will report to the VP, ALX Enterprise.

A key priority of the role is to develop and scale corporate training as a new and strategic growth lever for ALX. This requires a builder mindset, with the ability to originate opportunities, structure offers, and close deals in an evolving space. Beyond corporate training, you will also identify and close additional revenue-generating partnerships and commercial collaborations that contribute directly to the sustainability of ALX’s mission.

Specific Responsibilities

Revenue Generation and Pipeline Ownership

• Close new and expansion revenue against a quarterly and annual target.

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals from prospecting to signed contract. Run discovery with CEOs, CHROs, CPOs and L&D heads to understand their strategy and leadership

title: Onboarding Team Lead
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

As our new Onboarding Team Lead, you’ll manage and develop our Onboarding team while ensuring that new Merchants receive world-class support and menu standards from day one.

What you’ll be doing

As Onboarding Team Lead, you’ll be responsible for building a high-performing team that delivers a seamless onboarding journey for our partners. You’ll set the direction, lead by example, and ensure that processes, tools, and best practices are in place to support scalable growth.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Lead and develop the onboarding team of Onboarding Associates and Specialists

• Ensure excellent onboarding experiences for partners together with the team

• Work closely with Sales, Support, and Account Management teams to align on partner success

• Develop onboarding processes and automations that improve efficiency and partner outcomes

• Analyze the local country market on an ongoing basis to refine processes and identify improvements

• Create a positive work environment that enables the team to grow and succeed

• Lead by example by demonstrating Wolt’s values and behaviors

• Conduct regular one-on-ones to monitor performance, provide feedback, and support professional growth

Our humble expectations

• Minimum of 2 years in onboarding, customer operations, or implementation in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

• 1+ year leading individual contributors as a shift lead or team lead, including running 1:1s, coaching, and performance feedback.

• Proven track record hitting team SLAs/KPIs for new-partner launches, with experience in capacity planning and scheduling.

• Hands-on experience standardizing SOPs and rolling out process improvements that scale quality and speed.

• Cross-functional onboarding experience partnering with Sales, Support, and Account Management to ensure clean handoffs.

• Tooling experience with CRM/workflow systems and spreadsheets/BI (e.g., Salesforce or similar; Excel/Google Sheets; Looker/Power BI).

• Experience running QA for menus/content and maintaining strong data hygiene across systems.

• Experience managing escalations via defined playbooks and closing the loop with stakeholders.

• Fluency in both Czech and English is a must.

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring - learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

What You Bring

• Demonstrated expertise with NEC, NFPA, zoning, environmental regulations

• Track record of influencing internal stakeholders and external regulators

• Certifications such as PMP, ICC Permit Technician, OSHA 30, NFPA, LEED preferred

• Strong analytical, documentation, and process-building capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenLabs operates a complex and fast-evolving revenue model - enterprise contracts, self-serve API subscriptions, usage-based billing, and expanding international markets. As a Revenue Accountant, you will play a key role in ElevenLabs’ revenue accounting function.

You will own significant portions of the monthly revenue close, support the application of ASC 606 to customer arrangements, and help build scalable processes and controls as ElevenLabs grows toward IPO readiness.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Billing Operations, Engineering, and FP&A to support contract review, usage and billing completeness, new product launches, and accurate and timely revenue recognition. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean Finance team - the right person will independently run recurring workstreams, identify issues early, and help scale the revenue accounting operating model as the business grows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Execute significant portions of the monthly revenue close, including journal entries, deferred and unbilled revenue schedules, reconciliations, and flux analysis

- Perform recurring usage / consumption completeness and billing-to-GL reconciliations; investigate exceptions and drive resolution with cross-functional partners

- Review customer contracts and apply established ASC 606 guidance

title: Clinical Research Manager
description:
Category: Pharma/Biotech/Clinical Research

Location:

The Clinical Research Manager (CRM) is responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of clinical trials conducted across various phases. This role ensures that studies are executed in compliance with regulatory requirements, GCP/ICH guidelines, and internal SOPs. The CRM manages cross-functional teams, monitors timelines and budgets, and acts as the primary liaison between investigators, CROs, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead the planning, execution, and management of clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas and phases.
Oversee site selection, study start-up, patient recruitment, data collection, and close-out activities.
Ensure compliance with FDA, ICH-GCP, and other applicable regulatory standards.
Develop and maintain project timelines, budgets, and resource plans.
Supervise and mentor Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Clinical Trial Assistants (CTAs), and study coordinators.
Review and approve study documentation including protocols, CRFs, informed consent forms, and monitoring reports.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams including regulatory affairs, data management, biostatistics, and medical writing.
Manage vendor and CRO relationships, including contract negotiations and performance monitoring.
Track and report on study metrics and provide regular updates to senior leadership.
Oversee the preparation and conduct of audits and regulatory inspections.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or related field (Master’s or Ph.D. preferred).
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in clinical research, including 2+ years in a managerial or supervisory role.
In-depth knowledge of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
Proven experience managing Phase I-IV trials across multiple therapeutic areas.
Strong project management, leadership, and team coordination skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Proficiency with clinical trial software (e.g., CTMS, EDC, eTMF platforms).
Ability to travel up to 20% as needed.

In addition to a dynamic and collaborative work environment, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well-being. Our benefits include paid holidays, Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, and medical insurance to ensure our team members have the flexibility and coverage they need. We believe in fostering a healthy work-life balance while providing the necessary support for professional and personal growth.
